Pricing

Services

Website design, development, and optimization

We help small businesses, entrepreneurs, freelancers, and local brands get a modern, clear, technically stable website.

What we do

Services shaped around real project needs

Each project starts with what the website needs to achieve. Structure, design, development, and support are then planned around that goal.

  1. 01

    Website creation

    Presentation, business, and portfolio websites that clearly explain services, content, and brand identity.

  2. 02

    Web design and user experience

    Visual hierarchy, content layout, and responsive design that make the website easier to understand and use.

  3. 03

    Development and implementation

    Custom code or WordPress solutions, depending on the structure, content, and maintenance needs of the website.

  4. 04

    SEO foundations and performance

    Semantic structure, metadata, speed, crawlability, and a technical foundation for visibility without false promises.

  5. 05

    Online stores

    E-commerce functionality when a project needs products, a catalog, checkout, or online payments.

  6. 06

    Maintenance and support

    Content updates, technical support, security checks, and improvements after launch.

In detail

What each service means in practice

No unnecessary jargon: the goal is to understand what is included, when you need it, and how it helps your website.

01

Website creation

We build websites that present services, work, organizations, or products in a clear and professional way.

This is the right fit when you need a new website, or when your current site no longer represents your business well.

02

Web design and UX

We treat design as a practical tool, not decoration: it should help visitors understand the offer and know what to do next.

It matters when you have content, but the page feels unclear, outdated, or does not guide visitors well enough.

03

Website development

The technical approach depends on the project. Sometimes WordPress is the best fit; sometimes a custom modern frontend is more appropriate.

This matters when the website needs to be easy to maintain, fast, extensible, or adapted to a specific workflow.

04

SEO and performance optimization

We put the technical foundations in place for users and search engines: clear pages, metadata, internal links, speed, and sound structure.

It is needed when you want a website that can be understood, indexed after launch, and used comfortably across devices.

05

Maintenance and support

After launch, a website often needs content updates, technical checks, and gradual improvements as the business changes.

This is useful when you want long-term stability, regular updates, and support without unnecessary complexity.

Who it is for

For businesses that need a clear, reliable online presence

We usually work with clients whose website needs to explain a service, present work, make contact easier, or support sales.

  • small businesses and local brands
  • entrepreneurs and freelancers
  • organizations and schools
  • service-based businesses
  • brands that need a redesign or modernization

Process

How collaboration works

The process stays simple and understandable, but detailed enough for everyone to know what is being built and why.

  1. 01

    Discovery and goals

    We clarify who the website is for, what it needs to present, and which project priorities matter most.

  2. 02

    Structure and content

    We organize pages, messages, and materials so visitors can find the important information quickly.

  3. 03

    Design

    We shape the visual direction, hierarchy, and responsive layout around the brand and the website goal.

  4. 04

    Development

    We implement the website, connect pages, and keep the technical foundation stable.

  5. 05

    Testing and optimization

    We check layouts, links, basic accessibility, metadata, performance, and behavior across screen sizes.

  6. 06

    Launch and support

    We prepare the website for launch and define what should be maintained or improved afterward.

Working standard

What we consider on every project

These are not decorative promises. They are practical criteria that affect how useful, fast, and maintainable the website is.

Responsive design

The website should be readable and usable on phones, tablets, laptops, and larger screens.

Clear structure

Navigation, headings, sections, and internal links should help both users and search engines.

Performance

Images, code, and layout are planned so pages stay fast and stable.

Maintainability

The website should be possible to update and improve without unnecessary technical clutter.
